entries.zh: 择地；择地理——选看地方、相地择址（或指堪舆择地）
entries.en: to choose land, to select a site; land-selection
entries.notes: 汉字栏带「idem」（同上）互见标记，不影响本条释义。

entries.zh: 挑来挑去；反复拣择、挑拣不定（犹疑难决）
entries.en: to keep picking and choosing back and forth; to be choosy, indecisive
entries.notes: 西语栏「Da ynada le Conciencia」残句难通，释义依汉字「择来择去」与闽南、官话音注拟定。

entries.zh: 选考；经考察选拔、考选
entries.en: to choose by examination; to select after testing

entries.zh: 点定；选定、指定（escogido＝被选中的，señalado＝被指定的）
entries.en: to choose and designate; chosen, designated

entries.zh: 密；隐藏、密藏；保密
entries.en: secret, hidden; to hide, to keep secret
entries.notes: 闽南音注四音节中两处标为污损难辨（T99）、字形未定，释义以汉字「密」与西语 esconder/guardar 为据。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语词头、汉字、官话对音三栏均空缺（[空]），仅存三音节闽南注音，无从定义。

entries.zh: 藏；躲藏、隐藏；收藏（另有一读）
entries.en: to hide, to keep; to store away (an alternative reading is noted)
entries.notes: 闽南栏为同一字并列两读，异读标记「l.」依推断，两读均涉隐藏、收藏义。

entries.zh: 匿；隐藏、藏匿
entries.en: to hide, to conceal; to lie hidden

entries.zh: 怀藏；揣在怀中收藏、贴身藏着
entries.en: to keep or conceal in one's bosom

entries.zh: 拾藏；把拾得之物藏起来、拾得藏匿（字头辨认可疑）
entries.en: to pick up and hide what one finds; to pocket found goods
entries.notes: 汉字栏有〔疑:拾/恰〕之辨，释义据西语 esconder lo que se halla（藏起拾得之物）与闽南、官话音注拟定。

entries.zh: 怀；揣在怀里、藏于怀中
entries.en: bosom; to hide in one's bosom

entries.zh: 藏匿；藏起来、隐匿
entries.en: to hide, to conceal

entries.zh: 藏密；藏匿保密、密藏
entries.en: to hide and keep secret

entries.zh: 躲开藏匿；离去而躲藏（字头有〔疑:忘/忐〕之辨）
entries.en: to go off and hide; to keep out of sight
entries.notes: 汉字栏〔疑:忘/忐〕待考，「去」似为趋向前缀，释义由西语 esconder 与闽南、官话音注推定。

entries.zh: 怀；藏于怀中、揣怀
entries.en: to conceal in the bosom; bosom

entries.zh: 怀密；怀中密藏、贴身密藏
entries.en: to keep hidden in one's bosom; to carry secretly

entries.zh: 漏饷；隐匿货物、逃避关税（马尼拉贸易语境）
entries.en: to hide one's goods and not pay the (customs) duty; to smuggle past the tax

entries.zh: 走饷；逃税、避缴关税（一走了之）
entries.en: to run from the duty; to evade the (customs) tax

entries.zh: 偷藏；偷偷藏起、暗中藏匿（或指藏匿偷来之物）
entries.en: to hide secretly, to stash away covertly

entries.zh: 密藏；秘密藏匿
entries.en: to hide secretly, to conceal
entries.notes: 闽南栏并列一异读形式（「l.」标记），不涉词义。

entries.zh: 藏掖丑恶、遮掩弊病；把不好的东西藏起来（释义存疑）
entries.en: to cover up something foul or bad; to conceal an abuse (gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏〔疑:弊/樊〕且闽南音注两音节污损难辨（T99），仅据西语 esconder algo por feo malo 拟释义。

entries.zh: 潜藏；躲藏、隐匿（字头有〔疑:偷/潜〕之辨）
entries.en: to hide, to lie concealed
entries.notes: 汉字栏〔疑:偷/潜〕待考，官话对音仅存一音节，释义由西语 esconder, ocultar 推定为潜藏。
